title: PPO net2 on net1 v5: the learner with scaled rewards and a critic warm-up
description: The first debug run (exp-net2-ppo-debug-80, on net1 v4) showed the cloned start matching the rule on validation (+0.010 over 126 pairs) but a critic that did not learn: returns summed per-step utilities over about tau / 10 ms steps, so their scale was about 100, value loss 1e3 to 1e4 and explained variance near 0 until the last iteration, and the actor drifted on noise. Now each step's reward is scaled by 1 - exp(-10 ms / tau), so a return is a discounted mean utility, and the first 3 iterations update only the value network. The same cell on net1 v5 (exp-net1v4-recheck-79), from the rule at u = 0.125 (v5's own u is being chosen in parallel), 20 iterations, evaluated every fifth on the validation links' new-conditions family and paired with the rule. A debugging run, not a result.
run: S="$OUT/spec-s$SEED.json"; jq --argjson s "$SEED" '.seed = $s | .iterations = 20' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/ppo-s$SEED" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
